key_findings: Passerini reaction generated alpha-acyloxycarboxamides with diverse TRPV1/CB1/CB2 activity and metabolic stability.
Compound 41 is a balanced TRPV1/CB2 agonist selective over CB1, TRPM8 and TRPA1.
